$description: The translucency axis (port-manifest §8.6). Solid is the baseline and the fallback: the frosted values are applied additively inside an @supports (backdrop-filter) block so an engine without backdrop-filter gets the solid values with no separate rule, and prefers-reduced-transparency forces them back. Only chrome surfaces frost — sidebar, popup container, modal scrim, toast, tab bar. Content surfaces stay solid. CSS-only: Android has no equivalent axis, it uses opaque Material surfaces.

solid.$description: Default, and what [data-translucency="off"] or an engine without backdrop-filter gets.
